_comment: Quality floors enforced by CI (scripts/check_eval.py) on every pull request.
These are deliberately data, not code: ratcheting a floor up after a real
improvement is a one-line diff that shows in review, and loosening one to
make a build pass is equally visible. Set them below the current measured
numbers by enough margin that seed-level noise cannot flake the build, and
raise them when a change genuinely earns it.
llm_triage_accuracy is absent on purpose: CI has no model, so the triage
step runs rules-only there. The LLM number is measured on the build
machine by `make eval` and reported in the README.
